# SecureChat: Real-Time Private Messaging Application

## Project Introduction

SecureChat is a modern, secure real-time messaging application built with Next.js 16 and TypeScript. The project focuses on providing private one-to-one communication with end-to-end security considerations and real-time message delivery capabilities.

### Purpose Statement
SecureChat aims to deliver a seamless messaging experience with enhanced privacy features, leveraging modern web technologies to create a responsive and secure chat platform.

### Core Goals and Objectives
- **Privacy-First Design**: Built with security as a core principle
- **Real-Time Communication**: Instant message delivery using Pusher Channels
- **Modern User Experience**: Clean, intuitive interface with responsive design
- **Scalable Architecture**: Serverless-ready architecture for cloud deployment

### Target Audience
- Users seeking secure private messaging
- Developers looking for a modern chat application template
- Teams requiring real-time communication tools

## Technical Architecture

The application follows a modern full-stack architecture with clear separation of concerns:

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Client Browser] --> B[Next.js App Router]
    B --> C[Authentication Layer]
    B --> D[API Routes]
    D --> E[Database Layer]
    D --> F[Realtime Service]
    F --> G[Pusher Channels]
    E --> H[(PostgreSQL)]
    
    I[React Components] --> J[State Management]
    J --> K[Realtime Hooks]
    K --> L[Pusher Client]
```

### Component Breakdown

**Frontend Layer**: React components with Next.js App Router for routing and server-side rendering
**Backend Layer**: Next.js API routes handling business logic and data operations
**Realtime Layer**: Pusher integration for instant message delivery
**Data Layer**: PostgreSQL database with Drizzle ORM for type-safe queries

### Design Patterns
- **Server-Side Rendering (SSR)**: For improved performance and SEO
- **Component-Based Architecture**: Reusable UI components
- **Service Layer Pattern**: Separation of business logic from API routes
- **Real-Time Event Handling**: WebSocket-based communication through Pusher

### System Relationships
The application uses a layered architecture where the frontend communicates with backend services through RESTful APIs, while real-time updates are handled through Pusher Channels for instant messaging capabilities.

## Key Implementation

### Main Entry Points
- **Application Root**: `app/layout.tsx` - Root layout with global styles and metadata
- **Auth Layout**: `app/(auth)/layout.tsx` - Authentication-specific layout wrapper
- **Chat Layout**: `app/(chat)/layout.tsx` - Protected chat application layout

### Core Modules
- **Authentication**: `lib/auth.ts` - Better Auth configuration and session management
- **Database Schema**: `lib/db/schema.ts` - Type-safe database schema definitions
- **Realtime Service**: `lib/realtime/index.ts` - Pusher integration and event broadcasting
- **Middleware**: `middleware.ts` - Route protection and authentication guards

### Configuration Approach
- **Environment Variables**: Centralized configuration in `.env.local`
- **Build Configuration**: `next.config.mjs` - Next.js specific settings
- **Database Config**: `drizzle.config.ts` - Database connection and migration settings

### External Dependencies
Key dependencies include:
- **Next.js 16**: Modern React framework with App Router
- **Better Auth**: Authentication and session management
- **Drizzle ORM**: Type-safe database queries
- **Pusher**: Real-time messaging infrastructure
- **Tailwind CSS**: Utility-first styling framework

### Integration Points
- **PostgreSQL Database**: Primary data storage via Drizzle ORM
- **Pusher Channels**: Real-time event streaming
- **Vercel Analytics**: Production analytics integration
- **Google Fonts**: Typography optimization

```mermaid
graph LR
    A[User Interface] --> B[API Routes]
    B --> C[Business Logic]
    C --> D[Database Operations]
    C --> E[Realtime Events]
    E --> F[Pusher Service]
    D --> G[(PostgreSQL)]
```

## Key Features

### Functionality Overview
- **User Authentication**: Secure login/register with email/password
- **Real-Time Messaging**: Instant message delivery with presence indicators
- **Conversation Management**: One-to-one chat conversations
- **Message History**: Persistent message storage and retrieval
- **User Presence**: Online/offline status tracking
- **Typing Indicators**: Real-time typing status display

### Implementation Highlights
- **Protected Routes**: `middleware.ts` - Server-side route protection
- **Real-Time Hook**: `hooks/useRealtime.ts` - Custom hook for WebSocket connections
- **Chat Components**: `components/chat/` - Modular chat interface components
- **Validation**: `lib/validations/` - Request validation with Zod schemas

### Feature Architecture

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Unauthenticated
    Unauthenticated --> Authenticated: Login/Register
    Authenticated --> Chatting: Start Conversation
    Chatting --> Typing: User Types
    Typing --> Chatting: Message Sent
    Chatting --> Offline: Disconnect
    Offline --> Chatting: Reconnect
    
    state Chatting {
        [*] --> ReadingMessages
        ReadingMessages --> SendingMessage: Send
        SendingMessage --> ReadingMessages: Delivered
    }
```

The application provides a complete messaging solution with modern web technologies, focusing on security, performance, and user experience. The modular architecture allows for easy maintenance and future enhancements while maintaining clean separation between different system components.
